purpose: Value a special opportunity or effort.
keywords: せっかく + clause; often ので / なら / のに; せっかくの + N
Since we have come all the way to the sea, let us take a short walk.
I went to the trouble of making it, but no one ate it.
It is a precious day off, so I want to relax.
formation: せっかく + clause; often ので / なら / のに; せっかくの + N
restrictions: ので and なら make use of an opportunity; のに marks wasted effort or disappointment.
mistake: Choose the ending to show whether the opportunity is used or lost.
